title: Oister Global launches Rs 600 Cr deeptech fund
summary: Oister Global aims to invest in about 8-10 deeptech startups with a proven business model & technology and its capital will assist in rapid scaling.
llm_summary: Oister Global has unveiled a Rs 600 crore deep‑tech fund aimed at backing roughly 8–10 startups that already have a proven business model and technology. The capital will be used to accelerate product development, market entry and rapid scaling, helping these ventures move quickly
